title: Normalize URL slugs
goal: Update sandbox/text_app/slug.py so slugify(title) returns a URL-safe lowercase slug where every run of non-alphanumeric characters becomes one hyphen.
constraints: Do not modify the check file.
Keep the function signature as slugify(title: str) -> str.
expected_behavior: Leading and trailing separators are removed.
Repeated separators are collapsed to one hyphen.
